AND CENTER_ID = ( SELECT CENTER_ID FROM TB_MANAGERINFO WHERE MANAGER_ID = #{mberId} )
AND CENTER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ROLE_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{selectRoleCode}, '%')

SELECT CENTER_ID AS centerId, CENTER_NM AS centerNm, CENTER_ZIPCODE AS centerZipcode, CENTER_ADDR1 AS centerAddr1, CENTER_ADDR2 AS centerAddr2, CENTER_TEL AS centerTel, CENTER_FAX AS centerFax, CENTER_USERID AS centerUserId, CENTER_REGDATE AS centerRegdate, CENTER_UPDATEID AS centerUpdateId, CENTER_UPDATE_DT AS centerUpdateDt, CENTER_IMG AS centerImg, CENTER_URL AS centerUrl, CENTER_IMG_MAP AS centerImgMap, CENTER_EQUIPMENT_CMT AS centerEquipmentCmt, CENTER_USEYN AS centerUseYn, CENTER_LOUNGE AS centerLounge, CENTER_MEETINGROOM AS centerMeetingRoom, CENTER_INFO AS centerInfo, SUBSTRING(CENTER_ZIPCODE FROM 1 FOR 3) AS centerZipcode1, SUBSTRING(CENTER_ZIPCODE FROM 4 FOR 3) AS centerZipcode2, ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, CENTER_STARTTIME AS centerStartTime, CENTER_ENDTIME AS centerEndTime, CENTER_GUBUN AS centerGubun, BROD_CODE AS brodCode FROM TB_CENTERINFO WHERE CENTER_ID = #{centerId}
SELECT CENTER_ID, CENTER_NM, BROD_CODE FROM TB_CENTERINFO WHERE CENTER_GUBUN = 'BRANCH01' AND BROD_CODE IS NOT NULL
